Netflix show's filming location, Musafir Cafe, is a real Uttarakhand cafe

The Musafir Cafe, featured in the new Netflix show starring Vikrant Massey, is a real establishment located in Mussoorie, Uttarakhand. Viewers can reportedly visit and even stay at the cafe, which served as a filming location for the series. The cafe's existence and accessibility have been highlighted following the show's release.
